snippet.title: Rage Trip Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
A difficult pixel-art platformer where the game roasts every mistake. Play solo, race friends, or try Shared Fate: 2–4 players, and one death resets the whole team. Beat your best times, clear a level together, earn animated skins. Free demo available - wishlist the full game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5503500/Rage_Trip/
